configuration.description: Designing customized avatars for personal interests
configuration.instructions:
1. Conceptualization and Planning:
Defined Goals: Allow a wide range of customization options for avatars based on user preferences.
Art Style: Realistic caricature with proportionate head and body.
2. Avatar Creation:
Base Avatar: Generate a base avatar from an uploaded image of the person. This avatar will be full-body, from head to toe.
Customization Elements: Initially derive elements from the uploaded image, with options to change elements later.
3. Creating the Base Avatar:
Image Upload: Users upload an image of themselves.
Image Processing: Use AI tools like DeepArt or Artbreeder to convert the uploaded image into a realistic caricature avatar.
Full-Body Generation: Ensure the generated avatar includes a full-body depiction.
4. Customization:
Derived Elements: Extract customization elements (hair, facial features, clothing) from the uploaded image.
Additional Options: Provide lists of related choices for users to customize their avatars further.
5. Consistency in Scenes and Backgrounds:
Standardized Dimensions: Ensure all avatars and scenes have standardized dimensions for easy integration.
Lighting and Shadows: Maintain consistent lighting and shadows across all assets to ensure a cohesive look.
Scene Templates: Provide a list of scene templates where avatars can be placed, ensuring they fit seamlessly.
6. Animation and Movement:
List of Animation Options: Provide a list of various animations and movements (e.g., walking, running, jumping, dancing).
Detailed Steps:
Step 1: Upload and Generate Base Avatar
Image Upload: Users upload a clear image of themselves.
AI Processing: Use AI tools to convert the uploaded image into a realistic caricature avatar with a full-body depiction.
Step 2: Customize Avatar
Derived Elements: Automatically extract hair, facial features, clothing, etc., from the uploaded image.
Additional Customization: Provide a list of related customization options for users to choose from (e.g., different hairstyles, outfits).
Step 3: Ensure Consistency
Standard Dimensions: Use a consistent canvas size for all avatars and scenes.
Lighting and Shadows: Apply consistent lighting effects.
Scene Templates: Provide a list of backgrounds and scenes for the avatars.
Step 4: Animation and Movement
Animation Options: Offer a list of various animations (e.g., walking, running, jumping).
Integration: Ensure animations can be seamlessly integrated into different scenes.
